messages:
claire: Quick sync — handing off regional capacity for eu-west-2 tomorrow AM. Owners: ajay for routing, maya for db replica, jordan for kms/residency. Need final 👍 from ops-oncall for cutover window.
ajay: I'm happy to own routing. Question: do we default to routing-policy=v2 or use sticky-residency for initial canary?
maya: db replica is ready in staging; I'll run a smoke-sync at 06:30 UTC. Need the schema migration PR merged: https://git.company/internal/db-migrations/pull/234
jordan: KMS is provisioned but waiting on IAM role from security. Pinged @security. Without IAM can't attach key to VPC private deployment.
ops-oncall: Can do 07:00-08:00 UTC window, prefer 07:15 to avoid batch jobs. :thumbsup:
claire: @ajay let's use sticky-residency for the canary to verify session affinity. If it looks good, switch to v2 auto-route in 24h.
ajay: sgtm. I'll add fallback routes to us-west if latency > 250ms. Also need a quick code review on the route config: https://git.company/infra/route-config#L120 — @jordan @maya can you review?
jordan: reviewing now, small nit in TTL handling. Will open a PR comment.
maya: merged migration PR. smoke sync passed in staging. will coordinate cutover script at 07:05 UTC.
claire: Ops, confirm that monitoring dashboards have the new region charts (latency/cost/errors).
sam (deploy-bot): deploy queued: region-provisioner v1.14 -> staging at 06:45 UTC. Status will post here.
ops-oncall: dashboards updated, added alert: region_eu_latency > 250ms for 3m -> page.
jordan: sec-team approved IAM role, attached KMS key. Good to go from my side.
ajay: route-config PR submitted: 1987654330. cc @claire @ops-oncall
claire: OK final checklist: (1) PRs merged (2) KMS attached (3) DB replica caught up (4) smoke pass. If all green, proceed 07:15 UTC canary. I'll start the runbook and post link.
jordan: one follow-up: we still need to confirm data residency flags for logs — will follow up with logging team, but not blocking cutover.
claire: noting blocking items: logging residency follow-up (post-cutover), everything else green. Thanks team :tada:
